title: Stress Buffering
hook: Being calm all the time sounds great until a real deadline needs you fired up.
statement: Train your body to switch states, calm, focused, or energized, on purpose.
explainer: Being chill isn't resilience if you can't find urgency when it counts. Resilience is having more than one gear and shifting between them on command.
sop: Learn one quick cue per state: cold water to activate, slow breath to calm.
Score your State Diversity and Flex from 1 to 10.
Use the right cue before you need it, not after you're overwhelmed.
Practice switching daily in low-stakes moments.
Keep the cues that work for you. Drop the rest.
equation_example: State Diversity 6, Flex 7. 6 × 7 = 42. Higher means you can meet a tough moment in the right state. Lower means one bad moment tends to color your whole day.
question: Name the state you struggle to reach on command, and one cue you'll practice.
closing_statement: Resilience is how many gears you can reach on command.
